population.title: Population growth, regional Queensland, 2024-25
population.publisher: Queensland Government Statistician's Office, using ABS Regional population released 31 March 2026
population.note: Tables 1 and 2 report Redland City population and annual population increase. These are estimated resident population figures, not Census counts.

census.title: Redland 2021 Census All persons QuickStats
census.note: The median age is a 2021 Census measure. It is not presented as a 2026 estimate.

economy.title: Local Disaster Management Plan, December 2025, pages 31-32
economy.publisher: Redland City Council, reproducing NIEIR and ABS economic data
economy.note: Figures 9 and 10 identify NIEIR 2024 estimates for GRP, local jobs and employed residents, and ABS 2024 for businesses. The tourism and agriculture section reports 2023-24 measures. These are dated observations, not live or newly estimated 2026 figures.

profiles.title: City profile, insights and data
profiles.period: Council's current profile and research hub
profiles.note: Provides economic, community, housing and industry profiles and downloadable snapshots. Each linked publication has its own reference period.

southernIslands.title: Southern Moreton Bay Islands demographic and employment snapshot
southernIslands.publisher: Redland City Council, using the 2021 ABS Census
southernIslands.note: The snapshot's Southern Moreton Bay Islands statistical geography includes Coochiemudlo Island. Its figures must not be described as the population of only Russell, Macleay, Lamb and Karragarra islands.

minjerribah.title: North Stradbroke Island / Minjerribah demographic and employment snapshot
minjerribah.publisher: Redland City Council, using the 2021 ABS Census
minjerribah.note: Reports whole-island population, median age and age composition. These are Census observations, not current visitor numbers or 2026 population estimates.

budget.title: Annual Budget 2026-27
budget.note: Budgeted revenue and capital works are plans, not actual spending. The 5.47% general-rate comparison applies to the median owner-occupied Category 1A property and is separate from utility and other charges.

budgetDocument.title: Budget Publication 2026-2027 (PDF, 29 MB)
budgetDocument.note: The full document is linked from Council's annual budget page. Dashboard budget figures are checked against that page's published summary.

annualReport.title: Annual Report and Community Financial Report 2025-26
annualReport.note: Links to the latest annual report, financial statements and community financial report, separate from the forward budget.

minutes.title: Council meeting minutes and agendas
minutes.note: Council links to its InfoCouncil register and states that minutes from 2007 onwards are available online.

meetingRegister.title: InfoCouncil meeting document register
meetingRegister.note: This is the register linked from Council's minutes and agendas page.

livestream.title: Council meeting livestreaming and video recordings
livestream.note: Council directs residents to its webcast archive and official YouTube channel for live and recorded meetings.

youtube.title: Redland City Council on YouTube
youtube.note: This exact channel address is linked from Council's website. The Live tab contains live and recorded broadcasts; broadcasts are only live when a meeting is in progress.

webcast.title: Council meeting webcast archive
webcast.note: The current archive listed the 14 October 2026 General Meeting when checked.

schedule.title: Council meeting schedule
schedule.note: Check Council's schedule for the meeting date, time and location before attending or watching.

birkdale.title: About Birkdale Community Precinct
birkdale.period: Planning update following the July 2026 General Meeting
birkdale.note: Council reports that the whole-of-precinct Local Government Infrastructure Designation was formalised. This is a planning milestone, not a statement that the precinct or whitewater centre is complete.

capalaba.title: Capalaba Town Centre: sales suite and project update
capalaba.publisher: Redland City Council, Your Say Redlands Coast
capalaba.note: The dated Council update describes a $183 million renewal project. This differs from the undated $250 million figure on Council's RIC overview, so the dashboard identifies the date of the chosen estimate.

capalabaOverview.title: Capalaba Town Centre: RIC project overview
capalabaOverview.note: The overview gives a $250 million estimate. The dated 12 March 2026 update gives $183 million. The dashboard identifies both sources without inferring the undated page's age or a final project cost.

toondah.title: Toondah Harbour PDA: current status and next steps
toondah.note: Council acknowledges Walker Group's withdrawal as development partner and describes work with the Queensland Government on future directions.

weinam.title: Weinam Creek Priority Development Area Project
weinam.note: Council reports completed land resumption and a state-led EDQ design tender for the multi-storey car park.

dunwich.title: Dunwich Ferry Terminal Upgrade
dunwich.publisher: Queensland Department of Transport and Main Roads
dunwich.note: TMR identifies the project as planning and says feedback from May-June 2026 consultation will inform the business case. The page gives different dates for planning and business-case completion, so no completion deadline is inferred here.

cleveland.title: 14 October 2026 Council meeting: Cleveland Town Centre update
cleveland.note: Public agenda item 9.2 is Cleveland Town Centre Revitalisation Project Update; a separate confidential update appears at item 19.4. A listed item alone does not establish a project value or delivery milestone.
